rec.name: PDP Delivery Time & Stock Status Communication
rec.status: Built — launched (delivered in the test theme; install instructions were being reworked to be theme-independent)

what.text: A configurable product-page block that shows a colored status dot and a short availability or delivery message directly above the Add to Cart button. It covers four states: In stock (for example 'Auf Lager - in 1-2 Werktagen bei Dir'), Low stock ('Nur noch [count] übrig'), Overselling/Preorder ('Bald wieder auf Lager' or 'Ab dem [next_incoming_date] wieder auf Lager'), and Sold out ('Bald wieder für dich verfügbar'). The message updates live when the shopper switches variants. Every state has its own editable text, text color and background color, all maintained in one place in the theme editor.

why.text: Delivery certainty is one of the biggest sources of purchase anxiety. A green dot with a clear promise such as 'in stock, in your hands in 1-2 working days' lowers perceived risk right at the decision point. A red or amber low-stock message adds honest scarcity and urgency. Preorder and incoming-date messaging keeps out-of-stock shoppers on the page and sets expectations instead of losing them. Placing the message next to the CTA means it is seen at the moment of commitment.

how.text: Add an 'inventory' block schema (limit 1) to the product section's blocks. Create an inventory.liquid snippet that checks the selected variant's availability, inventory_policy, inventory_quantity, incoming and next_incoming_date to pick one of the four states. The snippet renders the text with a colored 10px dot (a ::before pseudo-element) and replaces the [count] and [next_incoming_date] placeholders. Render the snippet from product-form.liquid via a `when 'inventory'` case. Also output a JSON map of per-variant HTML. Add a small <product-inventory> custom element to theme.js that listens to the form's 'variant:changed' event and swaps in the matching HTML. Merchants then edit texts and colors in the theme editor. The PL team also asked for a pulsing dot animation (like Bestelectronic), an option to hide the dot, and per-part coloring (for example only 'Auf Lager' in green). The code supplied covers per-state colors, but the pulse animation and hide-dot toggle are not visible in the delivered code.

items: In stock: label text, label color, text after label, text color, background color
Low stock: low inventory threshold (range 0-100, 0 = always show in stock), text with [count] placeholder, color, background color
Overselling/Preorder: text, incoming-stock text with [next_incoming_date] placeholder, color, background color
Sold out: text, color, background color
Requested but not confirmed in the delivered code: pulsing dot animation, option to hide the dot, link of the text to a product metafield

dependencies.text: Needs a theme with a main-product / product-form structure that supports blocks, plus the ability to edit theme.js and add a snippet. The code was written for a specific theme (Dawn-like, with a variant:changed event). Inventory tracking must be enabled in Shopify. The Preorder and incoming-date states depend on the variant's inventory_policy 'continue' (sell when out of stock) and on Shopify's incoming inventory and next_incoming_date data from transfers or purchase orders. The Shopify Admin handles this data, with no separate app mentioned. Install instructions had to be rewritten to be theme-independent for non-developers. Some customer-facing German default texts are hard-coded.

items: Conversion rate on low-stock and preorder products
Support tickets or contacts about delivery time
